name: Iron Spike
summary: Hammer into wood or earth to jam a door or anchor a Rope or Chain; sold in tens.
text: Iron Spikes are sold in bundles of ten (1 GP and 5 lb. for the bundle). As a Utilize action, you can drive a spike into wood, earth, or similar material with a blunt object such as a Light Hammer, either to jam a door shut or to tie a Rope or Chain to it.
